rows.section: Personal income tax (daň z příjmů fyzických osob, § 16)
rows.note: 23% applies to the part of the tax base above 36× the average wage (CZK 48,967 in 2026). Monthly withholding uses 3× the average wage, CZK 146,901 a month. The tax base is rounded down to whole hundreds of crowns; credits are deducted from the tax.

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Digital Nomad programme (Program digitální nomád)
rows.value: IT and marketing specialists from Australia, Brazil, India, Israel, Japan, Canada, South Korea, Mexico, New Zealand, Singapore, United Kingdom, United States, Taiwan: employees of a foreign employer with at least 50 staff, or freelancers with a Czech trade licence; long-term visa decided within 45 days
rows.note: Self-employed contribution figures are the 2026 amounts published by ČSSZ and VZP; paušální daň amounts are those published by the Financial Administration.
rows.source_title: Ministerstvo průmyslu a obchodu: Program digitální nomád (version of 1 July 2025)

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Digital Nomad programme: income requirement
rows.value: At least 1.5× the average gross annual wage announced by the Ministry of Labour
rows.note: Self-employed contribution figures are the 2026 amounts published by ČSSZ and VZP; paušální daň amounts are those published by the Financial Administration.
rows.source_title: Ministerstvo průmyslu a obchodu: Program digitální nomád (version of 1 July 2025)

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Digital Nomad programme: tax consequence
rows.value: No special regime: a nomad who becomes tax resident (183 days or a home in Czechia) pays Czech income tax; freelancers also pay Czech social and health insurance
rows.note: Self-employed contribution figures are the 2026 amounts published by ČSSZ and VZP; paušální daň amounts are those published by the Financial Administration.
rows.source_title: e-Sbírka: Zákon č. 586/1992 Sb., o daních z příjmů, consolidated version in force from 1 August 2026, § 2

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Long-term visa for business (vízum k pobytu nad 90 dnů za účelem podnikání)
rows.value: Trade licence or company registration, accommodation and funds of 50× the existence minimum (CZK 156,500); valid up to 1 year, then a long-term residence permit for business
rows.note: Self-employed contribution figures are the 2026 amounts published by ČSSZ and VZP; paušální daň amounts are those published by the Financial Administration.
rows.source_title: Ministerstvo vnitra: Prostředky k pobytu pro účely dlouhodobého víza

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Where to apply
rows.value: Visa: a Czech embassy or consulate abroad (decided by the Ministry of the Interior); residence permit renewals: the Ministry of the Interior (OAMP); Digital Nomad inclusion: the Ministry of Industry and Trade; trade licence: a trade licensing office (živnostenský úřad)
rows.note: Self-employed contribution figures are the 2026 amounts published by ČSSZ and VZP; paušální daň amounts are those published by the Financial Administration.
rows.source_title: Ministerstvo vnitra: Prostředky k pobytu pro účely dlouhodobého víza
